description: Prepares a short film from one sentence: 3 to 6 shots, about 15 to 30 seconds, the same character throughout, with sound, music and editing. Returns the link to Cirrela's Film page with the idea filled in, where the person gets story ideas and a storyboard, sees the cost in credits, and makes the film with one tap after signing in. Nothing is rendered or spent in the chat, and no sign-in is needed to get the link. Fits "make a video of…", "fais une vidéo de…", "haz un vídeo de…", "faça um vídeo de…" when the person wants a little story rather than one clip.

idea.description: The film in a sentence or two: who, where, what happens.

language.description: Optional: the page's language, usually the one the person writes in. Default en.

name: create_film
title: Prepare a short film from a sentence
